text:
sam_sales: Heads up Enterprise prospect 'FinEdge' asking for a 12mo commit. Traffic profile: baseline ~250 RPS chat, two daily spikes to 900 RPS for 30m, plus background embeddings ~60 RPS. They want reserved GPU recommendation, autoscale rules, burst credits, and short security checklist for the quote.

olivia_se: quick clarifiers are embeddings inline or async? avg response token target? any rerank fan-out?

sam_sales: embeddings mostly async but ~25% inline for rerank. Avg response ~150 tokens; plan for 220 tokens to be safe.

david_platform: rough plan: size reserved for baseline + 25% buffer -> 312 RPS target. For spikes use prewarmed burst + autoscale to handle 900 RPS. Key knobs: KV prefix cache for frequent intents, adaptive batching, and prewarm pool to reduce cold-start tail.

david_platform: suggested starter config (subject to perf run):
reserved_pool: 7 x A100
prewarm_burst: 3 x A100
autoscale_max: 11 x A100
kv_cache: enabled
batching: adaptive, max_tokens_per_batch=6144

sara_ops: ops notes place reserved across 2 AZs, preheat 10m before expected peaks, enable spot fallback but keep N+2 reserved for SLA. Autoscale policy: scale on tokens_in_flight + avg_queue_ms, add one unit every 30s, cooldown 4m.

nina_cs: security checklist request: SOC2, BYOK for keys (for Private/Dedicated), audit logs (12mo), embedding retention controls and deletion API. We'll provide SOC2 + pen test summary; need ops to confirm KMS regions.

pricing_bot: sample finance layout for $130k/mo commit: 68% baseline reserved ($88.4k), 22% burst credits ($28.6k), 10% overage buffer ($13k). Map reserved to GPUs after perf numbers.

david_platform: I'll run perf bench tomorrow with model variant and a sanitized trace to estimate RPS per GPU and tokens/sec. Expect numbers posted here.

sara_ops: POC plan: 72h sandbox with traffic replay (sanitized), two scheduled spikes, chaos (AZ loss). Deliverables: runbook, SLA draft, telemetry access, and preheat cron snippet.

sam_sales: blockers: 1) perf numbers 2) KMS region confirmation 3) final pricing mapping.

action items: david  perf bench (tomorrow), sara  SLA + runbook (tomorrow), nina  security pack (today), pricing_bot  quote variants (tomorrow noon). I'll send NDA + trace request to customer. :thumbsup:
